sources.title: DINOv2: Scalable Self-Supervised ViT Model
sources.snippet: DINOv2 is a self-supervised vision model based on Vision Transformer architecture that generates universal visual features without requiring fine-tuning. It uses a student-teacher framework with untied projection heads and efficient attention mechanisms to enhance feature diversity and stability during training. The model achieves state-of-the-art performance in image classification ...
